# Nimeplay

> Minimal anime streaming with no ads, comments, popups, or other distractions.

Nimeplay serves a server-rendered anime catalog and a public read-only JSON API.
All URLs below are stable and safe for automated agents to crawl.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nimeplay.sachnun.workers.dev/): Anime catalog, browsable by ongoing or completed status.
- [Anime detail](https://nimeplay.sachnun.workers.dev/anime/5114): Metadata and episode list for one anime.
- [Episode player](https://nimeplay.sachnun.workers.dev/anime/5114/1): Streaming page for one episode.
- [Genre](https://nimeplay.sachnun.workers.dev/action): Anime filtered by genre slug.
- [History](https://nimeplay.sachnun.workers.dev/history): Watch history stored locally in the browser.

## API

- [OpenAPI spec](https://nimeplay.sachnun.workers.dev/openapi.json): Machine-readable description of the JSON API.
- [API docs](https://nimeplay.sachnun.workers.dev/docs): Interactive API documentation.
- [Anime list](https://nimeplay.sachnun.workers.dev/api/v1/anime): Paginated list; query params `type=ongoing|completed`, `page`, `q`.
- [Anime detail](https://nimeplay.sachnun.workers.dev/api/v1/anime/5114): Metadata and episodes for one anime, keyed by MyAnimeList ID.
- [Episode detail](https://nimeplay.sachnun.workers.dev/api/v1/anime/5114/1): Streaming sources for one episode.
- [Genres](https://nimeplay.sachnun.workers.dev/api/v1/genres): All genres.
- [Genre detail](https://nimeplay.sachnun.workers.dev/api/v1/genre/action): Anime in one genre.

## Optional

- [robots.txt](https://nimeplay.sachnun.workers.dev/robots.txt): Crawling rules.
- [Favicon](https://nimeplay.sachnun.workers.dev/favicon.svg): Site icon.
